english.title: Money laundering - conceal etc the proceeds of another
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing or having reasonable grounds to suspect that property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..), was, or in whole or in part directly or indirectly represented, another person's proceeds of criminal conduct, concealed that property for the purpose of assisting **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to avoid prosecution for an offence under Part VI of the Criminal Justice Act 1988 or the making or enforcement in **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)'s case of a confiscation order
english.legislation: Contrary to section 93C(2) and (4) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS PERMIT THIS LEGISLATION TO BE USED FOR ANY OFFENCE WHICH STARTED BEFORE ITS REPEAL EVEN IF THE OFFENCE WAS NOT COMPLETE UNTIL AFTER THE 23rd FEBRUARY 2003 (Statutory instrument 2003/120)

(ii) See section 93a(7) for meaning of 'criminal conduct'.(iii) Two prior convictions for a Class 'A' drug trafficking offence may make him/her liable for a minimum sentence of seven years imprisonment under the provisions of section 313 of the Sentencing Act 2020.(iv) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
